purpose: Teach: 高架/岩石/邸宅/蜘蛛/蝉/コスモス/重油/広辞苑

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、高架線路の近くだろ?
lines.en: Riku, your place is near the elevated railway line, right?
lines.style: Casual, direct observation. Slightly teasing lilt on the question. Light energy — calling him out on something she already knows.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、岩石採集が趣味だったな、桜
lines.en: You used to collect rocks as a hobby, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet counter-move. Warm but deliberate — he's deflecting by remembering something about her first. Soft, almost tender in delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で邸宅建築の単元やったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you studied mansion architecture in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Pressing forward with gentle insistence. No real pause between questions. She's building something; he'll catch on eventually.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: You're scared of spiders, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet turn. He's caught her pattern now. Speaking softer, almost amused at himself for following the same game.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、蝉の抜け殻集めてたな
lines.en: Riku, you used to collect cicada shells.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement, not a question this time. Dry edge underneath — she's showing she can play his game too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏にコスモス見たろ?桜
lines.en: You saw cosmos flowers in the summer, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Softer now. He's matching her tone shift. Still curious but the edge is gentler — they're understanding each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で重油タンカーの単元やったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you studied heavy oil tankers in social studies, right?
lines.style: Back to the pattern. She's circling — there's a reason for all these questions. Calm, almost resigned delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、図書館で広辞苑引いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were looking up words in the comprehensive dictionary at the library, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final piece settling into place. Close and quiet now. The questions were never random — he's been listening the whole time.
